title: Best Email Copywriters (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire an email copywriter for newsletters, sequences and campaigns: what to include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: Email copywriters write the words in your newsletters, welcome sequences, launches and sales emails. Good email copy feels personal, gets opened and leads readers to one clear next step. It goes wrong when subject lines mislead, emails try to say everything at once, or the tone does not match your brand. This guide helps you hire someone who writes emails people want to read.

faq.q: What types of emails can a copywriter write?
faq.a: Welcome sequences, newsletters, product launches, promotions, abandoned cart emails, re-engagement emails and follow-ups after purchase.
Very. They decide whether the email is opened. Ask for several subject line options for each email so you can test them.

faq.q: Does the copywriter set up the emails?
faq.a: Usually not. Copywriters write the text; setting up automations and templates is often separate. Check the package.

faq.q: How long should an email be?
faq.a: Long enough to make one point well. Many emails work best with one message and one call to action.

faq.q: Can the writer use my existing content?
faq.a: Yes. Blog posts, videos and product pages can be turned into emails, which keeps your message consistent.
